title: Framework exclusions
description: What the framework is NOT responsible for. Written because FWK-104's repository validator found governance/scope/exclusions.yaml declaring this $id with no schema behind it -- an instance claiming conformance to a schema nobody defines is unverifiable by construction. Canonical serialization: UTF-8 JSON, keys sorted, separators (',',':').

exclusions.description: A scope with only inclusions can answer 'is this mentioned?' but never 'is this outside the mandate?', which is why at least one exclusion is required.
